from plg031_common import *
sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK/'iar-demo-tools'))
from run_demo import child_env
kind,host=sys.argv[1:];assert kind in ('fresh','update') and host in HOSTS
base=WORK/'p31/fresh' if kind=='fresh' else WORK/'public028/fresh'
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
env=child_env(base,host);env.update(GIT_CONFIG_COUNT='2',GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0='core.longpaths',GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0='true',GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1='core.autocrlf',GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1='false')
for k in ('CODEX_HOME','CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR','APPDATA','LOCALAPPDATA','TEMP'):Path(env[k]).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
prefix=kind+'-'+host+'-'
def native(label,args):
    r=command(prefix+label,[HOSTS[host],*args],cwd=base,env=env,timeout=240);assert r.returncode==0,label;return r.stdout
def market(label):
    r=json.loads(native(label,['plugin','marketplace','list','--json']));rows=r['marketplaces'] if host=='codex' else r
    return next(x for x in rows if x['name']=='se-harness')
def installed(label):
    r=json.loads(native(label,['plugin','list',*(['--marketplace','se-harness'] if host=='codex' else []),'--json']));rows=r['installed'] if host=='codex' else r
    return next(x for x in rows if x['pluginId' if host=='codex' else 'id']=='verity-plane@se-harness')
def gitcache(cache,label):
    r=command(prefix+label,['git','-c','safe.directory='+cache.as_posix(),'-C',cache,'rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=base,env=env);assert r.returncode==0;return r.stdout.strip()
version=native('version',['--version']).strip()
report={'host':host,'kind':kind,'host_version':version,'profile':str(base),'source':'https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness#plugin-marketplace','observed_at':now()}
if kind=='fresh':
    before=json.loads(native('before',['plugin','marketplace','list','--json']));rows=before['marketplaces'] if host=='codex' else before;assert not any(x['name']=='se-harness' for x in rows)
    native('add',['plugin','marketplace','add','mmzen/se_harness','--ref','plugin-marketplace','--json'] if host=='codex' else ['plugin','marketplace','add','mmzen/se_harness@plugin-marketplace'])
else:
    prior=installed('before');assert prior['version']=='0.2.1'
    source=market('source-before');cache=Path(source['root' if host=='codex' else 'installLocation']);assert gitcache(cache,'revision-before')==OLD
    record=load(base/(host+'-active.json'));oldpath=Path(record['installed_path'])
    assert oldpath.resolve().is_relative_to(base.resolve())
    for name,digest in record['files'].items():assert sha(oldpath/name)==digest,name
    report.update(starting_version='0.2.1',starting_source=report['source'],starting_revision=OLD,starting_plugin=prior,starting_installed_path=str(oldpath),starting_files=record['files'],starting_method='Existing actual public 0.2.1 installation from WO-PLG-028; unchanged installed inventory verified before native update.')
    native('refresh',['plugin','marketplace','upgrade' if host=='codex' else 'update','se-harness',*(['--json'] if host=='codex' else [])])
response=native('install' if kind=='fresh' else 'update',['plugin','add' if host=='codex' else ('install' if kind=='fresh' else 'update'),'verity-plane@se-harness','--json'])
row=installed('after');assert row['version']=='0.2.2',row
source=market('source-after');cache=Path(source['root' if host=='codex' else 'installLocation']);assert cache.resolve().is_relative_to(base.resolve())
assert gitcache(cache,'revision-after')==PUBLIC
path=Path(json.loads(response)['installedPath']) if host=='codex' else Path(row['installPath']);assert path.resolve().is_relative_to(base.resolve())
package=DIST/'packages'/host/'verity-plane';files={p.relative_to(package).as_posix():sha(p) for p in package.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
for name,digest in files.items():assert sha(path/name)==digest,name
active=native('active',['debug','prompt-input','List installed Verity Plane skills.'] if host=='codex' else ['plugin','details','verity-plane@se-harness']);assert 'harness-orient' in active
report.update(status='pass',revision=PUBLIC,marketplace=source,plugin=row,installed_path=str(path),files=files,content_sha256=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(files,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(),evaluator_version='0.20.0',plugin_version='0.2.2',all_installed_bytes_match=True,active_method='Native debug prompt-input' if host=='codex' else 'Native plugin details')
write(N/(prefix+'route.json'),report)
print(json.dumps({'host':host,'route':kind,'status':'pass','file_count':len(files)}),flush=True)

from plg031_common import *
sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK/'iar-demo-tools'))
from acceptance_native import claude_probe,assess,snapshot,Codex
prior=load(EV.parent/'WO-PLG-030/native-qualification.json')
report={'observed_at':now(),'status':'pass','public_revision':PUBLIC,'prior_evidence':'docs/engineering/release-0-20-0/evidence/WO-PLG-030/native-qualification.json','prior_sha256':sha(EV.parent/'WO-PLG-030/native-qualification.json'),'comparisons':[],'public_hook_checks':[],'limits':'Windows CLI only. Earlier verified startup, manual compact, resume and boundary traces reused under VER-PLG-029 after exact package, fixture and host version comparison. No new model response, desktop or automatic threshold compaction claim.'}
for host in HOSTS:
 root=WORK/('plg030-native/repo-'+host)
 assert snapshot(root)==prior['fixture_file_identities'][host]
 print(host,'prior installed keys',list(prior['installed_packages'][host]))
 for kind in ('fresh','update'):
  route=load(N/(kind+'-'+host+('-retry1' if host=='codex' and kind=='update' else '')+'-route.json'))
  old=prior['installed_packages'][host]
  assert route['files']==old['files']
  base=Path(route['profile']);out=N/(kind+'-'+host+'-native');out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
  manifest={'demo':str(base),'host_executables':HOSTS}
  report['comparisons'].append({'host':host,'route':kind,'files_equal':True,'fixture_equal':True,'host_version':route['host_version'],'fixture_file_count':len(snapshot(root)),'prior_installed_identity':old})
  if host=='claude':
   _,contexts,replies=claude_probe(manifest,root,out,'public-startup',hook_only=True)
   result=assess(root,contexts,replies,hook_only=True);assert result['passed'],result
   report['public_hook_checks'].append({'host':host,'route':kind,'assessment':result,'invocation':load(out/'public-startup.invocation.json'),'contexts':contexts})
  else:
   client=Codex(manifest,out)
   try:
    result=client.rpc('hooks/list',{'cwds':[str(root)]})
    write(out/'registered-hooks.json',result)
    report['public_hook_checks'].append({'host':host,'route':kind,'registered_hooks':result,'method':'Native app-server hooks/list; registration only. Trusted hook execution is supported by the prior verified native run with exactly matching installed package and fixture.'})
   finally:client.p.terminate();client.p.wait(timeout=15)
write(N/'public-native-recheck.json',report)
print('Public native checks and exact input comparison complete')

plg031_public.py.text:
from plg031_common import *
import urllib.request
GH=r'C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\gh.exe'
def api(name,endpoint):
 r=command(name,[GH,'api',endpoint]);assert r.returncode==0;return json.loads(r.stdout)
def get(url):
 with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=60) as r:return r.read(),r.geturl()
latest=api('live-latest','repos/mmzen/se_harness/releases/latest');last=api('live-last','repos/mmzen/se_harness/git/ref/tags/last')['object']
while last['type']=='tag':last=api('live-last-tag','repos/mmzen/se_harness/git/tags/'+last['sha'])['object']
raw,url=get('https://pypi.org/pypi/se-harness/0.20.0/json');pypi=json.loads(raw);wheel=next(x for x in pypi['urls'] if x['filename']=='se_harness-0.20.0-py3-none-any.whl');sdist=next(x for x in pypi['urls'] if x['packagetype']=='sdist')
rawpages,url=get('https://mmzen.github.io/se_harness/publication-manifest.json');pages=json.loads(rawpages)
assert wheel['digests']['sha256']=='7bcfe788c5daaf670bcee25a235663e8210002ce79ffba7162317b1f0509a6e0'
assert latest['tag_name']=='v0.20.0' and last['sha']=='7253d13b212ad6f7df670021290fea32e81d66de'
assert pages['governance_commit']=='23ae2d1f6af0f1bf8484b95b0850cb0019eeb7db' and pages['candidate_commit']==last['sha'] and pages['release_record']=='RLS-SEH-029'
write(N/'public-surfaces.json',{'observed_at':now(),'status':'pass','methods':['GitHub release/latest API','GitHub last ref API','PyPI version JSON GET','Pages publication-manifest GET'],'evaluator':{'version':'0.20.0','wheel_sha256':wheel['digests']['sha256'],'sdist_sha256':sdist['digests']['sha256'],'wheel_url':wheel['url']},'markers':{'latest':latest['tag_name'],'last':last['sha']},'pages':{'url':url,'response_sha256':hashlib.sha256(rawpages).hexdigest(),'provenance':{k:v for k,v in pages.items() if k!='resource_files'},'resource_file_count':len(pages['resource_files']),'extraction':'Top-level publication identities retained; resource_files omitted from this compact observation.'}})
print('Other public surfaces match approved identities')
